game.name: The Research Facility

Layout.description: The tile map the level is built from.

rows.description: ASCII map rows: # wall, . floor, D door, K security door, X exit

bounds.description: Inclusive cell bounds [c0, r0, c1, r1]

Transform.description: Position on the floor plane (x east, z south) and facing.

Door.description: A sliding door in a map cell.

kind.description: door = opens for anyone, secure = keycard door, exit = emergency exit

openRadius.description: Opens when an allowed body is this close

speed.description: Fraction of fully open per second

Footsteps.description: Noise made while moving. Crouching is silent.

interval.description: Seconds between steps at walk speed

viewCone.description: Must be roughly facing it (full cone)

Interactable.description: Something the player can press E on.

runtimeId.description: Interactable id in the runtime list

detectTime.description: Seconds of continuous sight to trip the alarm

crouchTimeMultiplier.description: Detect time × when the player crouches

decay.description: Detection drains per second when out of view

reportInterval.description: Cameras re-report the player this often while active

KeycardLock.description: Unlocks when the holder of an item comes close.

ExitZone.description: Win line through an unlocked exit.

lineX.description: Escape when player x is below this

shadowMultiplier.description: × more when player crouched, still and power off

peripheral.description: Notices a standing player within this distance from any angle

GuardBrain.description: Guard AI state and tuning (see the guard state machine).

suspicionRate.description: Suspicion per second at full strength

closeDistance.description: Closer than this builds suspicion faster

chaseMemory.description: Keeps chasing this long after losing sight

unseen.description: Seconds since the player was last seen

lastKnown.description: Where the player (or a noise) was last noticed; null if never

Blocker.description: Furniture: blocks movement; tall ones block sight.

Presentation.description: Rendering / audio / HUD subsystem. Reads game state; has no gameplay effect.

rules.title: Terminal option 1 switches cameras on/off (needs power)
Terminal option 2 resets an active alarm (needs power)
Power off: guards use their dark sight range
Crouching shrinks how far guards see you
Crouched, still and in the dark: sight shrinks again
During an alarm guards see further, move faster, suspect faster and search longer
A camera that detects you raises the alarm and alerts every guard
During an alarm, a camera that still sees you re-alerts guards every 2 s and restarts the timer
The alarm switches itself off after its duration
E on the keycard puts it in the inventory

E on the locked security door without a keycard is refused

actions.text: Access denied. You need a security keycard.

actions.text: Lockdown lifted. The emergency exit is open.

rules.title: E on the sealed exit explains it is locked

actions.text: Sealed. Lockdown lifts only when the research drive leaves the archive.

rules.title: Unlocked doors slide open when the player is near
rules.note: The runtime eases `open` toward 1 at Door.speed per second (and back to 0 when nobody is near); the blueprint shows only the target.

rules.title: Unlocked doors open for guards too, except the emergency exit
rules.note: Same easing as R19. Guards also cannot plan routes through the exit or a locked security door (grid.walkable).

rules.title: Walking (not crouched) makes footsteps heard within 3 m
Sprinting makes footsteps heard within the sprint noise radius (Blueprint parameter)
A chasing guard who has finished reacting, sees you and is within 1.2 m catches you
Crossing the escape line through the unlocked exit wins
While a guard sees you, suspicion rises (faster when close, during an alarm, or when already alert)
rules.note: Exact runtime formula per frame: suspicion = min(1, suspicion + suspicionRate × strength × (alarm ? alarmSuspicionMultiplier : 1) × (INVESTIGATE/SEARCH ? alertMultiplier : 1) × (distance < closeDistance ? closeMultiplier : 1) × dt), where strength = max(0.15, 1 − distance / sight range). The blueprint expression language has no arithmetic yet, so the action only names the rate.

rules.title: When a guard cannot see you (and is not chasing), suspicion drains
rules.note: Exact: suspicion = max(0, suspicion − suspicionDecay × dt).

parameters.name: Guard sight range
parameters.description: How far a guard can see the player with the power on (before crouch/alarm multipliers). The dark range is separate and NOT Blueprint-controlled.

parameters.name: Guard chase speed
parameters.description: How fast a guard runs while chasing (before the ×1.2 alarm multiplier). The player sprints at 6 m/s.

parameters.name: Sprint footstep noise
parameters.description: How far guards can hear the player's running footsteps (halved through walls). Walking noise is separate and NOT Blueprint-controlled.

parameters.name: Alarm duration
parameters.description: Seconds the alarm sounds before switching itself off (camera re-reports restart it).

parameters.name: Camera detection range
parameters.description: How far a security camera can detect the player (×0.75 when crouched). Also sets the length of the visible cone.
